Crest 3D Whitestrips Drop to $35 on Amazon in Rare Post-Summer Discount

A Rare Price Drop on a Popular At-Home Treatment

Crest 3D Professional Effects Whitestrips are currently marked down by 24 percent on Amazon, bringing the price of the popular at-home dental treatment to $35. According to reports from NBC Selected, this discount matches some of the lowest prices seen for the product since the summer months, surpassing the price cuts offered during recent major shopping events.

The kit includes 22 individual treatments, featuring one strip designed for the upper teeth and one for the lower teeth. At the current sale price of $35, the cost breaks down to just under $2 per treatment session.

How the Product Works

Designed to offer results comparable to professional treatments without an office visit, the Crest 3D Whitestrips utilize an enamel-safe hydrogen peroxide formula. The manufacturer states that completing the full regimen can make teeth up to 18 shades whiter.

The product also features Advanced Seal technology, which is intended to prevent the strips from slipping during use. The treatment holds a 4.6-star average rating based on feedback from nearly 107,000 shoppers on Amazon.

Potential Side Effects and User Impact

While many users report positive results with stain removal—particularly for common concerns like coffee staining—some individuals may experience mild sensitivity during the whitening process. Dental professionals and product guides often note that temporary sensitivity is a common side effect associated with higher-strength hydrogen peroxide whitening formulas.

Practical Implications and Reader Verification

Shoppers evaluating this deal should consider the following points regarding what is confirmed versus unknown:

  • Confirmed: The product is currently listed on Amazon at 24 percent off, reducing the price to $35 for a 22-treatment kit.
  • Unknown: Expiration dates, inventory levels, and the exact end date of the promotional pricing are not specified by the retailer and may change without notice.

Readers interested in verifying the current pricing, product specifications, and availability can review the original coverage directly on the [NBC News Selected Report](https://www.nbcnews.com/select/shopping/crest-3d-whitestrips-deal-of-the-day-rcna604976).
